$comment: Project settings for the technical-team plugin. skills: extra skills per agent, keyed by agent name (a hired specialist's name works too); "*" applies to every agent. Project skills by name, plugin skills as <plugin>:<skill>. mcpServers: which agents may use which MCP server, keyed by the server's name as configured for Claude Code (.mcp.json or settings); the value lists agent names, or "*" for every agent. This file does not start servers and cannot grant tools: team agents already see the session's MCP tools, and this list tells them which ones are theirs to use. A server that is not listed is used by no team agent. Block tools for real with permissions.deny in .claude/settings.json (e.g. "mcp__github__create_pull_request").
